meta.title: Procedural Wojak Anatomy & Visual Asset Specification
meta.description: Comprehensive vector, polygon, coordinate, and parametric specifications for 100% procedural PIL drawing of Wojak archetypes, expressions, clothing, props, and demographic variations without external raster assets.

pipeline_stages: 2. Back Layer Rendering (Rear hair, back headscarf, back chignon bun)
4. Torso & Neck Rendering (Neck cylinder, torso shape, base clothes)
5. Outer Clothing Layer (Doctor coat, nurse scrubs, hospital gown, apron)
6. Head Silhouette & Fill (Parametric head polygon, skin tone fill)
7. Shadow & Cross-Hatching (45-degree angle hatching right of shade threshold x=330)
9. Age & Stress Creases (Forehead wrinkles, crow's feet, eye bags, nasolabial folds)
10. Facial Features (Eyes, pupils, sclera tint, eyebrows, nose, mouth cavity, teeth/tongue)
11. Facial Hair & Head Hair (Beard, stubble, bangs, headscarf front knot, tradwife headband)
12. Accessories & Eyewear (Spectacles, bandages, nose plasters, bruises)
13. Limbs & Hands (Arms polyline chain, hands ellipse/palm)
14. Props (Scrolls, tea cups, pasta pots, paracetamol box, clipboard, stethoscope)
15. Foreground FX (Tears streaming, sweat drops, steam puffs)

wobble_jitter.description: Simulates hand-drawn MS Paint shaky mouse line art using low-frequency sinusoidal sway combined with Gaussian noise.
wobble_jitter.formula: dx = sway * 0.5 + N(0, amp * 0.35); dy = -sway * 0.3 + N(0, amp * 0.35); sway = amp * sin(i * 0.8 + phase)

brush_caps.method: Draw circular disk at every polyline vertex with radius = round(width * supersample / 2) to eliminate seams.

double_pass_sketch.description: Adds characteristic messy MS Paint secondary sketchy stroke on key contours.

head_shapes.name: Classic Wojak / Feels Guy
head_shapes.description: The archetypal 2009 melancholy bald man with an egg-like sloping cranium and soft recessed jaw.
head_shapes.drawing_instructions: Draw smooth closed polygon with wobble amplitude 1.0; apply diagonal grey hatching on right side for x > 330.

head_shapes.name: Gigachad (Chiseled Jaw)
head_shapes.description: Hyper-masculine, sharply sculpted face with wide mandibular angles, cleft chin, high cheekbones, and thick muscular neck.
head_shapes.drawing_instructions: Use angular line joints; draw cleft chin line and deep jaw shading; widen neck by 30% and add internal neck tendons.

head_shapes.name: The Doomer
head_shapes.description: Depressed young man wearing a black knit beanie pulled low over forehead, unkempt bangs, gaunt hollow cheeks, and dangling cigarette.
head_shapes.drawing_instructions: Overlay dark knit beanie with vertical ribbing lines; draw messy hair tufts protruding beneath cuff; add gaunt cheek contours and cigarette smoke.

head_shapes.name: Soyjak (Open-Mouth Pointing)
head_shapes.description: Hyper-expressive open gaping agape mouth, elongated dropped jaw, spectacles, raised frantic eyebrows, and patchy neckbeard.
head_shapes.drawing_instructions: Extend jaw by 40px downwards; render black mouth cavern with white square teeth blocks and pink tongue; draw thick glasses and patchy chin stubble.

head_shapes.name: NPC (Gray Rounded)
head_shapes.description: Minimalist, flat slate grey, completely smooth geometric capsule head with blank expressionless stare.
head_shapes.drawing_instructions: Fill with flat slate grey #B0B4B8; suppress all shadow hatching, wrinkles, pupils, and ear notches; draw rigid geometric triangle nose.

head_shapes.name: Tradwife / Nonna
head_shapes.description: Two distinct feminine variants: Tradwife (soft oval jaw, wavy golden bob, blue floral headband, feminine eyelashes) or Nonna/Babushka (plump face, floral headscarf tied under chin, apron, round spectacles).
head_shapes.drawing_instructions: For Tradwife: render flowing golden bob and cornflower headband; for Nonna: wrap head in red patterned scarf tied beneath chin and add round wireframe spectacles.

head_shapes.name: Nordic Gamer (Yes Chad)
head_shapes.description: Right-facing side profile with prominent straight classical nose, clean 90-degree jawline, sculpted full blonde beard, and swept-back hair.
head_shapes.drawing_instructions: Draw pure right-facing profile; highlight straight nasal bridge, angular forward chin, golden sculpted beard block, and stoic blue eye.

expressions.name: Crying / Weeping
expressions.description: Streaming translucent blue tears flowing down cheeks, bloodshot pink sclera, peaked grief eyebrows, and trembling wavy downturned mouth.

expressions.name: Smug / Smirk
expressions.description: Asymmetric sneer: high arched questioning left eyebrow, low furrowed right eyebrow, half-closed heavy lids, and mouth curled up on right side.

expressions.name: Screaming / Shocked
expressions.description: Enormous gaping oval scream mouth cavity with teeth and uvula, wildly dilated circular eyes with pinpoint pupils, arched forehead panic wrinkles.

expressions.name: Deadpan / Stoic
expressions.description: Completely horizontal bar mouth, rigid straight eyebrows, centered unblinking dot eyes, zero emotional inflection.

expressions.name: Tired / Sunken Eye Bags
expressions.description: Deep purplish dark circles and concentric sagging eye bags, heavy drooping lids, slack exhausted mouth, drooping brow.

expressions.name: Bandaged / Bruised
expressions.description: Trauma hospital meme: head wrapped in white gauze bandage, plaster on nasal bridge, purple/yellow hematoma around right eye, raised swelling lump.

forehead_wrinkles.description: Horizontal wavy creases across the upper forehead indicating stress and advanced age.

crows_feet.description: Radiating fan creases at the outer lateral corner of both eyes.

nasolabial_folds.description: Deep parenthesis brackets extending from nostril wings down past mouth corners.

eye_bags.description: Concentric dermal sagging arcs beneath lower eyelids.

receding_hairline.description: M-shaped widow's peak or high bilateral temporal recession pattern.

grey_hair.description: Silver / grey tone with alternating salt-and-pepper stroke hatching.

grandma_bun.description: Spherical coiled chignon bun at crown/nape pinned with crossed hairpins.

clothing.name: Hospital Patient Gown
clothing.description: Loose, sterile pale cyan smock with wide open V-neck, short wide sleeves, and dangling tie strings at side/back.

clothing.name: Doctor / Lab Coat
clothing.description: Crisp white medical coat with structured lapels, center placket with buttons, and breast pocket holding medical pens.

clothing.name: Nurse Scrubs Tunic
clothing.description: Ceil blue or emerald medical scrub top with sharp V-neck, short sleeves, and chest ID pass badge.

clothing.name: Nonna / Grandmother Apron
clothing.description: White domestic cooking apron with ruffled shoulder straps, square bib, and waist tie over dark dress.

props.name: Giant Scroll (Waiting List / Scroll of Truth)
props.description: Exaggerated rolled parchment unfurling downwards from hands past canvas boundary, depicting bureaucratic waiting lists or healthcare delays.

props.name: Cup of British Tea
props.description: Porcelain teacup with delicate curved handle resting on a saucer, amber tea liquid, and rising sinusoidal steam wisps.

props.name: Nonna's Boiling Pasta Pot
props.description: Heavy two-handled cooking pot with boiling bubbles, overflowing yellow spaghetti strands draped over sides.

props.name: Paracetamol 500mg Medicine Box
props.description: Rectangular pharmaceutical drug carton held forward: white background, bold blue stripe, 'PARACETAMOL 500mg' label, red cross emblem.

props.name: Medical / Bureaucracy Clipboard
props.description: Brown masonite clipboard held in left hand, heavy spring clip clamp at top, checklist boxes and consultation notes.

props.name: Doctor Stethoscope
props.description: Medical stethoscope draped around neck: dual ear tubes looping over shoulders, converging into Y-connector tube and chest bell disc.

props.name: Bandaged Head (Medical Cranial Wrap)
props.description: Full cranial spiral gauze wrap around forehead and cranium with safety pin clasp and gauze texture for medical trauma and accident memes.
